title: Spin-charge deconfinement from a self-consistent dressing of Fierz-complete $(1+1)$d Dirac fermions
summary: We develop a self-consistent dressing for $(1+1)$d Dirac fermions with Fierz-complete four-fermion interactions, extending the spin-charge formalism of~\cite{Haddad2024}. By studying the associated composite connection, we characterize obstructions to trivializing the Dirac operator and prove a trivialization theorem under which spin-charge separation, half-infinite Wilson-line dressing, and flat-connection holonomy arise as regime limits of the single dressing.
